rules_evaluated.evidence: Prompts 1 and 3 both end 'Show me the diff before you commit' -- the pre-confirm shape this rule generally discourages. Judged as a deliberate design necessity rather than a violation: H2 'Read the diff and push back on a line', backed by 'The point: pushing back is core work', is this exercise's entire forcing function and requires seeing the diff BEFORE the commit lands. A post-action 'tell me what you committed' would force an amend/revert cycle to implement the push-back, breaking the exercise's own design -- filing a REVISE here and 'fixing' it would degrade the artefact's core teaching moment, so per dispatch-preamble guidance this is reported as PASS with the boundary named.
